reviews.review: With a little intoxication and the right mods anything is playable :)

Cons: Lack of sequels means overarching story is woefully incomplete
Animations are much lower quality than the overall graphics, making them feel super "off"
Lack of real consequences, since major choices don't have said sequel to be paid off in any way
Required open world objectives quickly get repetitive
Large amount of time spent driving the Nomad around and around the open world

Pros: Side missions are good
Combat is great and responsive
Romance targets feel believable and cute
Brings the Mass Effect space magic opera vibe front and center

TL;DR - Pick it up on sale if you like Mass Effect. The narrative and overall production quality feels worst than the main trilogy, but easily worth the time.
Play cause it's a Mass Effect. Love the gameplay tho. If you care so much bout the story, it is not related to the trilogy. Regardless, still a Mass Effect.
I am really enjoying this game. It isn't the original trilogy, but it isn't bad either.

This game is not a bad game, but it is the worst Mass Effect game. By in large the reason for that is that it's simply just clunky. I played this on an xbox controller and you need to hold the y button (or the activate button) for everything. Every door, every container, every time you want to talk to someone, you need to hold the activate button for it. I can only imagine how much of my time was taking by that and by the ship traveling. You see, to travel to a different planet you have to sit through a cutscene. You can skip the cutscene, but not for the first few seconds. The game likes to waste your time in several little ways like that. This is the primary reason as to why I believe this to be the worst Mass Effect game. If you choose to play this game, download a mod to remove these "features". With that being said, the game itself is beautiful. It's visually stunning in certain areas and it really does get that mass effect feel. I also really appreciate the characters in the game. They are all spins on the crew in Mass Effect 1. Drake is an old krogan who wants whats best for his people. He's not as bitter as Wrex is about the genophage but that's because he is literally an old man. He has seen it all. He knows the downfalls of Krogan society but understands them in a different way than Wrex. Peebee is a young asari tinkerer similar to Liara. But she actually acts like a young person. She's brash, doesn't think things through and act accordingly to that. All of the crew have creative spins on the mass effect 1 characters and it's something I like about the game. I think the best way to describe the difference between mass effect Andromeda and mass effect 1 is this. Mass Effect 1 is about surviving an unknown force that wants you dead. Mass Effect Andromeda is about surviving in an unknown area that wants you dead. It's a really good twist on the main franchise.
